objective: Preallocate CREATE INDEX backfill data prefixes from table-name length.

tasks.title: Preallocate CREATE INDEX data prefixes
tasks.result: CREATE INDEX backfill scans now use an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for data:<table>: prefixes.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for data:<table>: before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in CREATE INDEX existing-row backfill scan prefix construction.
Generated prefix bytes, transaction scan prefixes, BTree index entries, composite index entries, FTS/trigram backfill, HNSW backfill, row-cache reuse, and SQL results are unchanged.
Focused index tests were launched in parallel and printed Cargo file-lock wait messages before passing.
